name: Conventional heat generation
note: KKS main group letter for the whole boiler/steam generator area.

name: Pressure system — feedwater and steam sections
note: The boiler's actual pressure parts, in flow order.

name: Circulation system
note: Not used in a natural-circulation boiler — its presence or absence in a real HAG tag is itself a quick sanity check on whether the unit is drum-type or once-through supercritical.

name: Triflux system
note: A combined economizer/evaporator/superheater surface arrangement used in some once-through supercritical designs.

name: Pressure system drainage and venting systems
Fluid supply system for control and protection equipment
Support structure, enclosure, steam generator interior
Bunker, feeder and pulverizing system
note: The mills/pulverizers, not the raw coal handling & stacking system (that's under E).

name: Mill air system, carrier air system
Pulverized coal temporary storage bunker after central pulverizing system
note: Only present with indirect (central) firing, not direct/unit firing.

name: Pulverized coal bin, forwarding and distribution system
Oil temporary storage, pump and distribution system
note: Light/heavy fuel oil for start-up and flame stabilization.

name: Fan system, forced-draught fan (FD fan) system
Air heating system (flue-gas-heated)
note: Regenerative/tubular air preheater.

name: Flue gas exhaust (without flue gas treatment)
Furnace ash, slag and dust removal
Furnace ash removal, furnace slag removal, bed ash removal
note: Bottom ash system.

name: Flue dust discharge and return system
Cyclone dust removal and return system
Fluid supply system for ash, slag and dust moistening
Chemical flue gas treatment, adsorptive process
note: e.g. dry sorbent injection.

name: Chemical flue gas treatment, catalytic process
note: e.g. SCR/DeNOx.

name: Flue gas ducting system within HS
Steam, water, gas cycles
note: KKS main group letter for the whole steam-water cycle area (feedwater, steam, condensate).

name: Feedwater piping system (excl. feedwater pump and heating)
Feedwater pump system
note: Boiler feed pumps — in a supercritical unit these run at markedly higher discharge pressure than a subcritical drum plant.

name: HP desuperheating (attemperation) spray system
note: Especially critical on a once-through supercritical boiler, which has no steam drum to passively damp temperature swings — spray attemperation is the primary means of steam temperature control.

name: HP reducing station
note: Part of the HP bypass system, routing main steam around the turbine during start-up/trip.

name: Start-up steam system, shutdown steam system
Extraction steam piping for HP feedwater heating
Extraction steam piping for LP feedwater heating (main condensate)
LP feedwater heating system, condensate polishing plant
Independent demineralizing plant system
note: Condensate polishing.

name: Main machine sets
note: KKS main group letter for the turbine and generator.

name: Condensing system
note: Includes the condenser and its flash boxes.

name: Air removal system
note: Condenser vacuum/air ejector system.

name: Transmission gear between prime mover and driven machine, incl. turning gear
Turbine bypass station, incl. desuperheating spray system
note: HP bypass — dumps main steam to the reheat line / condenser, bypassing the HP turbine.

name: Lubricant supply system, dirty oil collection system
Sealing, heating and cooling steam system
Generator, complete, incl. stator and rotor
Conventional fuel supply and residues disposal
note: KKS main group letter for fuel handling.

name: Unloading and storage of solid fuels
Transport system
note: Belt conveyors from unloading to storage.

name: Mechanical treatment of solid fuels
note: Crushing, mixing, drying — the coal preparation plant, distinct from the mills under HF which sit right at the boiler.

name: Temporary storage system for milled raw coal
Supply of liquid fuels (light fuel oil)
Cooling water systems
note: KKS main group letter for the whole cooling water area.

name: Circulating water system
note: Main condenser cooling water — the largest single water flow in the plant.

name: Extraction, mechanical cleaning for direct cooling
note: Intake screens/trash racks.

name: Circulating water piping and culvert system
Circulating water pump system
note: CW pumps — typically the single largest auxiliary electrical load in the plant.

name: Recirculation cooling system, outfall cooling system
note: Natural draft / mechanical draft cooling tower, where used.

name: Condenser cleaning system
note: e.g. ball cleaning/Taprogge system.

name: Auxiliary cooling water system
note: Cools auxiliary equipment (oil coolers, air coolers, sampling coolers) separately from the main condenser CW.

name: Closed cooling water system
note: Closed-loop, treated-water cooling circuit for critical equipment, isolated from raw circulating water.

name: Water supply and disposal
note: KKS main group letter for raw/service/drinking water and effluent — distinct from the boiler-cycle-specific treatment under L.

name: Ion exchange, reverse osmosis system
note: e.g. for demineralization — makeup water treatment plant (DM plant).

name: Evaporation system
note: Alternative demineralization route in some plants.

name: Distribution systems (not drinking water, not cooling water)
Drainage system for storm water drains
Rainwater collection and drainage, incl. treatment
Grid and distribution systems
note: KKS main group letter for the switchyard/grid connection, subdivided by voltage level.

name: Power transmission and auxiliary power supply
note: KKS main group letter for generator output, station transformers, and the entire in-plant electrical distribution hierarchy.

name: Power transmission
note: Generator leads and generator transformer.

name: Generator circuit breaker, incl. cooling system
Generator transformers, incl. cooling system
note: Steps generator voltage up to grid voltage.

name: Medium-voltage distribution boards and transformers, normal system
Medium-voltage emergency distribution boards, (diesel) emergency power system
Low-voltage main distribution boards and transformers, normal system
Low-voltage sub-distribution boards and transformers, normal system
Power installations for large variable-speed drives
note: e.g. boiler feed pump VFDs.

name: Instrumentation and control equipment
note: KKS main group letter for control rooms, DCS cabinets, and unit-wide I&C functions that serve more than one process system.

name: Start-up control, set-point control (unit), incl. cabinets
Instrumentation and control cabinets for steam turbine set
Structures
note: KKS main group letter for buildings, taking the code of whichever process system they primarily house.

name: Medium-voltage distribution boards and transformers, general-purpose
Low-voltage main distribution boards and transformers, general-purpose
Low-voltage sub-distribution boards and transformers, general-purpose
Low-voltage distribution boards, converter, UPS and stand-by diesel power system
LV main distribution board
note: The specific switchboard itself, as distinct from the auxiliary transformer (BFT) that feeds it.

name: Emergency power generating equipment
note: e.g. the emergency diesel generator set, if not classified under X (heavy machinery).

name: Structures for conventional heat generation
note: The system-level grouping that UHA (boiler house) and the other boiler-related structure codes sit under.

name: Flue gas stack structure
note: Includes structure for flue gas circulation where applicable.

name: Structure for flue gas filtering system
Structures for steam, water, gas cycles
note: The system-level grouping that ULA (feedwater pump house) and related structure codes sit under.

name: Structures for common installations of steam-water cycle
Gas turbine building
note: Relevant for a combined-cycle or dual-fuel configuration; not applicable to a pure steam-only supercritical unit.

name: Structures for water supply and disposal
Structures for drinking water supply system
Control system cabinets
note: The system-level grouping for the unit control, boiler control, and turbine I&C cabinet codes below it.
